# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.14

Version 1.4.14 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.13

**Events that froze the controls on 64-bit builds.** On Android's 64-bit (arm64) build, Windows x64 and Linux x86_64,
some characters who go on talking by themselves after a talk never did, and the player was left with no control:

- **Gracie's car wash**: once you agreed and stood at her car, she never said "준비, 시작!!" (ready, go!); the player
  stayed at the car in the first wiping pose and nothing more happened;
- **Gulliver** on the beach: once he got up, he never spoke, and the player could not move;
- the same for the others who start a talk that way: the islander who wakes up, a snowman once you finish it, the
  golden axe's fairy, and the town tune board after its GBA choice.

The game marks the character who may start the next talk by itself, and the port's 64-bit builds compared that mark
with only half of the character's address, so it never matched. It now compares all of it. The 32-bit builds
(Windows x86, Android's armeabi-v7a) were not affected, and seamless acres had nothing to do with it (it froze the
same with the setting off).

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).
- If you are stuck in one of these events now, close the game and start it again (the autosave never saves in the
  middle of an event), then talk to the character again with this version.

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.14 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.14-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.14-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.14-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.14-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- **Gracie's car wash**, played by script in a town with the visitor set for the day, with seamless acres on and off:
  the 64-bit build of v1.4.13 froze exactly as reported (the player at the car, Gracie facing away); this version's
  64-bit build goes through the car wash, the end talk and the present, with the same positions and screenshots as
  the 32-bit build.
- **Gulliver**: v1.4.13's 64-bit build froze when he got up; this version gives the same screenshots, positions and
  present (a rare item) as the 32-bit build.
- The other characters that start a talk by themselves go through the same check, now fixed for all of them. A search
  of the sources for other places that cut an address to 32 bits found none.
- With the setting **off** and on the rest of the game, nothing changes: the same scripted play as before (43
  scenarios) gives the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.4.13 and on this version.
- An independent review of the fix. The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are
  unchanged; all unit tests pass.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.14, versionCode 10414).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- No test on a real arm64 device was possible here; arm64 runs the same 64-bit code that was checked on x86_64.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
